employees.description: We are not robots. Although we love automation
employees.description1: For over 6 years, we have been creating digital solutions for businesses: Telegram bots, mobile applications, CRM systems, and websites. During this time, we have completed more than 200 projects that help companies automate processes and increase efficiency.
employees.description2: Our team consists of developers, designers, and project managers. We work transparently — from analysis and design to implementation and support.
employees.description3: We deliver all projects on a turnkey basis — from idea and strategy to launch and maintenance. This approach ensures scalable solutions that integrate seamlessly into businesses and deliver real value.

steps.title: Route
steps.subtitle: to production
steps.description: Clear system where every step moves towards results

step1.title: Request acceptance
step1.description: We carefully study your request to understand the project goal, your expectations and task specifics. This is the starting point for quality work.

step2.title: Requirements gathering
step2.description: We conduct clarifying questions, interviews or briefings to record all wishes, limitations and specifics of the future product.

step3.title: Technical specification approval
step3.description: We form a technical specification that clearly describes stages, functions and results. We agree on it with you before starting the project.

step4.title: Interface design
step4.description: We develop UX/UI design that will be convenient, intuitive and visually appealing. We create prototypes and visual solutions.

step5.title: Development
step5.description: At this stage the project comes to life — programmers implement all functionality according to specifications and design layouts.

step6.title: Testing
step6.description: We check the system for bugs, errors and flaws. We make sure everything works stably on different devices and browsers.

step7.title: Launch and support
step7.description: We publish the project and monitor its correct operation. We provide technical support, updates and improvements as needed.
